translated_title: Madrid, ‘The New Miami’: Mexican Oligarchy and Politicians Turn Spain into a Favorite Destination
original_title: Madrid, "la nueva Miami": oligarquía y políticos mexicanos convierten a España en destino preferido
author: Armando G. Tejeda
meta_description: Former presidents Calderón, Peña Nieto and Salinas de Gortari enjoy a golden retirement in Madrid, the ‘new Miami,’ where figures like Elba Esther Gordillo also shop in the city's most exclusive districts.
